hypotheses.justification: Write a₁ = angular … (c.holdStart + t, η), a₀ = angular … (c.holdStart, η) and e = exp(-2·c.lam·t). If B < 0, then hz gives 0 ≤ |z| ≤ B·a₁² ≤ 0, because a₁² ≥ 0. So B·a₁² = 0, hence a₁² = 0 (B ≠ 0) and z = 0. By `weighted_angular_square_hold c η ht` (which needs only 0 ≤ t), a₀²·e = exp t·a₁² = 0. Since e > 0, a₀² = 0, and the goal reduces to 0 ≤ B·0, which holds. So the statement stays true without hB. Proof: split on 0 ≤ B. If 0 ≤ B, keep the existing proof. If B < 0, use the degenerate argument above (abs_nonneg and nlinarith or mul_eq_zero, then the hold identity with Real.exp_pos, then simp). In the existing proof, hB is used only in the last step, to make B·a₀² nonnegative.
